test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 30 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Pick the synonym of 'Eloquent'.
solution: The correct answer is: **Fluent**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"eloquent"** means expressing oneself clearly, powerfully, and effectively in speech or writing. It often refers to someone who communicates ideas persuasively. (स्पष्ट और प्रभावशाली ढंग से बोलने वाला) • **Example:** The speaker gave an eloquent speech that moved the audience to tears. • **"Fluent"** refers to the ability to express oneself easily and articulately, especially in a foreign language or in communication. (धारा प्रवाह बोलने वाला) • **Example:** She is fluent in both French and Spanish, which helps her in her international business dealings. • Hence, "fluent" is the synonym of "eloquent" as they both relate to effective and articulate communication. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Fluent**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Silent** (मौन): Refers to being quiet or not speaking. • **Example:** The room was silent after the announcement of the bad news. • **Shy** (शर्मीला): Refers to someone who is reserved, timid, or hesitant in social situations. • **Example:** The shy child hid behind his mother when strangers came to visit. • **Scattered** (बिखरा हुआ): Refers to being spread out or dispersed in various directions. • **Example:** The toys were scattered all over the room after the kids finished playing. ac:T921, The correct answer is: **2) Trypophobia**.
